name: Cincinnati Cube Challenge 2025
information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Assocation](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY0MjIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--ec2ad11aeeac5b1db82b4e5eb2f0a7be8cd05aba/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)


If you are a first-time competitor, the [Registration Process and FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CincinnatiCubeChallenge2025#52612-registration-process-and-faq-for-new-competitors) tab has useful information how the competition will look. All competitiors must read the [Competitior Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CincinnatiCubeChallenge2025#52613-competitor-information-must-read) tab before registering.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)
